description: This file defines the final class 'PipelineElementDeleted', which implements the 'PipelineElement' interface to represent a pipeline element indicating deletion of an entire string. It provides singleton access via 'INSTANCE', overrides methods for processing, visiting, and iterating over the element.

classes.name: PipelineElementDeleted
classes.description: A singleton class representing a pipeline element that signifies the deletion of an entire string in a processing pipeline.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of this pipeline element, which is 'DELETED'.

methods.name: onResolved
methods.description: Returns itself, indicating no further processing when resolved.

methods.name: onUnresolved
methods.description: Returns itself, indicating no change when unresolved.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Returns the next pipeline element provided by the supplier.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor and invokes its 'deleted()' method.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an empty iterator as this element contains no strings.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the simple name of the class.
